title: Anthropic Claude Code weekly limits increased 50 percent
summary: Anthropic announced a 50 percent increase to Claude Code weekly limits through 13 July for all Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise users, stacking on a recent 2x increase to five-hour limits. Concurrently, SDKs, GitHub Actions and third-party autonomous agents were moved into a separate paid API credit system, drawing sharp community backlash.

research.notes: Transcript attributes ongoing compute shortage as cause; mentions a SpaceX compute borrowing partnership which is unverified.
